changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0024. Operational columns and the idempotency record. CorrelationId lets an audit row point at the request without storing tokens. The tenant usage index supports a workspace AI quota that the user index cannot seek. Idempotency records stop a repeated check-in key from creating a second visit. Index review: IX_AiUsageRecords_Tenant_Created leads with TenantId for the quota count; UX_IdempotencyRecords_Key is the replay lookup. No index on every audit column. Performance note: token cleanup filters ExpiresAt and RevokedAt, which are selective maintenance writes, not a hot read path.

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM app.RolePermissions WHERE PermissionId IN (SELECT Id FROM app.Permissions WHERE Code = N'PLATFORM_ADMIN'); DELETE FROM app.Permissions WHERE Code = N'PLATFORM_ADMIN'; DROP TABLE app.IdempotencyRecords; DROP INDEX IX_AiUsageRecords_Tenant_Created ON app.AiUsageRecords; ALTER TABLE app.AuditLogs DROP COLUMN CorrelationId;
